rationale: The agent appears to have executed an exchange (exchange_delivered_order_items with specific item and product IDs and a gift card payment method) without first authenticating the user or confirming the changes. There is no visible authentication via name/ZIP or user-details lookup tied to the order, and no confirmation step with the user prior to performing the write, which violates the policy requirement to confirm every order-changing action. The agent also did not show validation that the new coffee machine met the requested pressure constraints (8 bar, fallback 9 or 7) or that the laptop was the cheapest i7 or above; there were product detail calls for two SKUs but not for the SKUs actually used in the exchange. The choice of gift card payment was made without discussing whether a price difference existed or confirming the customer’s preference at the moment of charge. Finally, the closing message asserts the exchange is in process without presenting tool results or confirmation details, making the final information unsupported. These issues collectively fail the pass bar.
